set.body:
Outcome

Use row-major-last-axis-fastest Ravel and image4s-locus order as the only logical image order and use direct GridDomain evidence for exact voxel identity.

Work

- Remove public ambiguous linear(Int), first-axis-fastest Indexing helpers, copyLegacyLinear, legacy fromLinear semantics, and the compensating VolumeOrdinalBridge domain and bijection.
- Route voxel identity through image4s-locus GridDomain and locus4s Index, Region, Selection, Field, and certified alignment.
- Migrate image, dataset, atlas, threshold, MVPA, archive, serialization, and fixture consumers to coordinates or exact typed indices.
- Reject persisted ordinal artifacts without the canonical versioned layout; do not retain a permanent runtime legacy migration path.
- Keep logical domain order independent of arbitrary physical Ravel strides.

Acceptance

- A 2x3x5x7 oracle proves coordinates, spatial ordinals, full sample order, direct GridDomain fields, and CanonicalArray access agree.
- Same-sized foreign grid and parcel owners fail without explicit certified alignment.
- No production symbol or record describes legacy first-axis-fastest ScalaFIM order.
- Region, selection, assignment, searchlight-center, and serialization tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- Repository search finds no ambiguous linear image access or raw ordinal crossing without domain evidence.
set.title: Remove legacy linear ordinals and adopt direct image4s-locus GridDomain indexing
